components.name: Primary action
components.description: Coral action with cool-white text, including in dark mode.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--primary); color: var(--primary-foreground); border-radius: 0.5rem; font-weight: 700; } .dark .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--primary); color: var(--primary-foreground); }

components.name: Equation tile
components.description: Square monospace tile that communicates equation feedback through semantic fill states.
components.css: .ds-equation-tile { aspect-ratio: 1; display: grid; place-items: center; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 0.55rem; font-family: var(--font-mono); font-weight: 700; } .ds-equation-tile[data-state=correct] { background: var(--tile-correct); color: var(--tile-correct-foreground); }

components.name: Supporting card
components.description: Quiet stats or primer container that supports the board without competing with it.
components.css: .ds-card { background: var(--card); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 0.625rem; padding: 1.5rem; } .dark .ds-card { box-shadow: none; }

narrative.overview: Mazzie is a focused equation instrument: a clean sheet, a small set of marks, and just enough colour to show what changed. Rounded display type gives it a friendly voice while monospace equations keep the rules exact. Light mode is crisp cool white; dark mode is readable cool charcoal with no sepia cast or hazy card halos.

rules.name: The Cool White Rule
rules.body: Light surfaces stay crisp and blue-neutral; dark surfaces stay cool charcoal.

rules.name: The Equation Alignment Rule
rules.body: Equation characters, values, and share output use the mono stack.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: Use surfaces, borders, spacing, and one restrained light-theme shadow; never add gradients or diffuse dark halos.

dos: Do keep the board as the primary visual anchor.
Do use cool-white text on the dark-theme coral action.
Do pair feedback colours with labels or descriptions.
donts: Don't use sepia whites or near-black night mode.
Don't use gradients, glow, blur, or oversized shadows.
Don't let shadcn-svelte defaults replace Mazzie's visual language.
